new_jobs.title: Market Operations & Analytics Specialist — Institutional
new_jobs.jd: **About Us** We're a global cryptocurrency exchange with a large international user base and deep liquidity across spot and derivatives. Our institutional business serves professional trading counterparties worldwide. The team is remote\-first and globally distributed — we care about what you can do, not where you sit. **The Opportunity** Professional trading flow — market makers, funds, asset managers — accounts for the bulk of volume on any major venue, and the programs sitting behind that flow decide whether it stays with you or moves elsewhere. Fee tiers, rebates, incentives, liquidity arrangements: this seat owns all of it, from structuring the program to modelling what it earns to proving the result afterwards. You'll work alongside business development, relationship management, product, and risk as the institutional side of the business scales. **Your Remit** * Run day\-to\-day operations for professional trading clients — market makers, hedge funds, asset managers, prop firms, brokers — covering onboarding, documentation review, and fee tier assessment * Structure liquidity arrangements and maker/taker rebate and incentive schemes, and see them through launch and post\-launch review * Model the commercial impact of fee and incentive changes before they go live, then measure what actually happened * Track how competing venues price and incentivise, and advise on where we should position * Own the reporting layer for institutional performance: volume, liquidity contribution, revenue by account * Work through large trading datasets to surface accounts worth pursuing and accounts going quiet, and pass those to the commercial team * Partner with engineering on colocation, API, and latency support for latency\-sensitive clients **What You Bring** * Several years in market maker operations, institutional client operations, trading operations, or exchange analytics — exchange\-side crypto experience is what we're after, though brokerage, derivatives, or traditional venue backgrounds are worth a conversation * Real exposure to professional counterparties: market makers, funds, asset managers, prop trading firms * Genuinely hands\-on analytics — SQL, modelling in Excel, Tableau or similar — and the ability to work from raw data rather than waiting on a polished internal data platform * Working command of maker/taker economics, rebate mechanics, order book liquidity metrics, and how market makers actually make money * Incentive programs you've built or run where you can point to what changed as a result * The ability to turn a spreadsheet into a recommendation someone senior can act on * Fluent English; Mandarin useful given the client mix * Suited to autonomy and a fast\-moving remote setup **Why Take the Call** This isn't a dashboard job. The fee and incentive structure for our institutional business is yours to shape — you build the case, you model it, and you see the volume respond. Direct line to institutional leadership, counterparties among the most sophisticated trading firms in the market, and an analytics function you get to build rather than inherit.

new_jobs.title: E-Commerce Operations Specialist

new_jobs.title: Manager, CM Business Management, Ring
new_jobs.jd: **Description** Ring is seeking a highly motivated and strategic Manager, CM Business Team to lead the Contract Manufacturer management function within the Ring Business Management organization. This role is critical to shaping and executing end\-to\-end manufacturing strategies, developing long\-term CM and supply chain strategies, managing strategic CM partnerships, and aligning global supply chain capabilities with Ring’s product roadmap and business priorities. The ideal candidate is a proven people leader with strong experience in the consumer electronics industry and a solid track record in strategy development, contract negotiation, cost management, supplier performance management, and cross\-functional business execution. This leader should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, able to influence across global stakeholder groups, and capable of translating complex business and supply chain challenges into clear, actionable strategies. The successful candidate will bring strong executive communication skills, sound business judgment, and a solution\-oriented mindset. They will build trusted partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, influence decision\-making across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain teams, drive CM performance and accountability, and develop a high\-performing team that can support Ring’s continued growth and operational excellence. Key job responsibilities Leadership \& Team Development * Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team by providing structured guidance, clear expectations, and ongoing support. * Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * Set clear priorities and ensure team execution is aligned with Ring’s business objectives, product roadmap, and operational goals. Supplier \& Contract Manufacturer Management * Serve as Ring’s primary business interface with global Contract Manufacturers (CMs), managing strategic relationships to optimize production efficiency, cost, quality, delivery, and overall supplier performance. * Lead CM selection, onboarding, contract negotiation, and performance management processes across new product introductions (NPI) and sustaining programs. * Build and maintain trust\-based, strategic partnerships with external suppliers and CMs to support Ring’s long\-term growth, product innovation, and manufacturing scalability. Cost \& Contract Negotiation * Lead complex commercial negotiations to secure best\-in\-class business terms, improve cost competitiveness, enhance flexibility, and mitigate supply chain and execution risks. * Develop and implement scalable cost reduction programs, value engineering initiatives, and operational efficiency improvements to strengthen Ring’s supply chain competitiveness. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to identify cost opportunities, validate business cases, and drive measurable financial impact. Strategic \& Operational Excellence * Translate diverse stakeholder requirements across Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Product, Quality, and Operations into clear, actionable CM strategies. * Drive strategic RFQs, manufacturing footprint optimization, CM allocation decisions, and technology readiness assessments in alignment with Ring’s product roadmap. * Develop long\-term CM strategies that balance cost, capability, capacity, risk, innovation, and portfolio health. * Stay current on industry trends, tariff developments, country\-of\-origin regulations, regional manufacturing shifts, and evolving global business dynamics to inform CM strategy and decision\-making. Business Communication \& Influence * Prepare and deliver clear, concise, and impactful executive\-level communications, business reviews, strategy documents, and decision papers. * Influence stakeholders across Amazon’s global ecosystem through data\-driven insights, structured recommendations, and strong business judgment. * Build alignment across senior leaders, cross\-functional teams, and external partners by simplifying complex business trade\-offs and driving decisions with clarity. Adaptability \& Innovation * Navigate ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing business priorities with agility, resilience, and a solution\-oriented mindset. * Identify and adopt scalable AI tools, systems, and mechanisms to improve operational efficiency, decision quality, and business visibility. * Champion continuous improvement and innovation in CM management processes, business operations, and team ways of working. **About The Team** Ring and Blink are committed to making neighborhoods safer by delivering accessible, reliable, and innovative home security products to customers around the world. The Supply Chain and Operations team plays a critical role in bringing this mission to life by supporting the business from product concept and development through NPI, launch, and sustaining operations. Within this organization, the Business Management team serves as the key business interface between Ring/Blink and our global manufacturing partners. You will work with teammates and cross\-functional stakeholders across regions to turn product ideas into scalable manufacturing plans that can be executed with speed, quality, and operational discipline. This is a team that operates in a fast\-moving, ambiguous, and highly cross\-functional environment. Success requires strong business judgment, ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence without always having direct authority. The work is challenging, but it directly impacts our ability to deliver trusted products to customers and advance Ring and Blink’s mission of making neighborhoods safer. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field * 5\+ years of people management and team development experience * Solid experience in supplier and Contract Manufacturer (CM) management within the consumer electronics (CE) industry. * Proven track record in contract negotiations and cost management, with measurable results. * 5\+ years of business development, direct technology services sales, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience * Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, manage change, and drive alignment among cross\-functional and global stakeholders. * Excellent professional business communication skills (English – written and verbal), with strong executive presence. **Preferred Qualifications** * MBA or advanced degree in Business, Operations, or related field. * Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C\-level executives and cross\-functional teams * Strong understanding of international supply chain dynamics, tariffs, and compliance requirements. * Experience developing operational processes and data insights * Experience implementing scalable tools and systems that improve efficiency in supplier/CM management. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into actionable strategies.
